source.label: Inria Aerial Image Labeling dataset page
source.method: one point per named city (10 cities, 36 tiles each); the georeferenced tiles are only inside a 20 GB split 7z archive without an index

note: 360 tiles of 1.5 x 1.5 km: train = Austin, Chicago, Kitsap County, Vienna, West Tyrol; test = Bellingham, Bloomington, Innsbruck, San Francisco, East Tyrol. City coordinates are approximate centres, not tile positions.
